title: DesignSpec
description: What Tinker (the AI designer) or the UI proposes. draft-service validates it, maps it onto a Draft template, runs the real Draft generator with its feasibility gate, and returns a body contract. Owner: morphology agent (may tighten/extend bounds; keep this file the single source of truth, ai-service reads it at runtime to build prompts).

name.description: Short creature name shown in the UI.

concept.description: One-sentence pitch in the user's words.

bodyPlan.description: quadruped = Draft's official four-legged template (3 joints per leg: hip roll, hip pitch, knee). multileg = radial or bilateral body with 3 to 8 identical three-joint legs (hip yaw, hip pitch, knee), generalised from the Flower crawler.

basePreset.description: Optional: start from a Draft preset's actuators and proportions, then apply the overrides below.

quadruped.description: Only for bodyPlan=quadruped. Metres. Omitted fields keep the preset/template value.

actuator.description: Actuator family; Draft sizes the motors from its fitted trends. qdd = quasi-direct-drive, fast and springy (best for jumping); geared = strong planetary, slower; harmonic = very strong, very slow; micro = small hobby-scale servos for small robots.

strength.description: Multiplier on the family's rated torque. Draft may flag strong/small combinations as infeasible.

arrangement.description: radial = legs evenly around a round hub (flower, starfish, octopus); bilateral = legs in left/right pairs along an elongated body (insect, crab, millipede-ish).

bodyAspect.description: Length/width of the hub; >1 elongates bilateral bodies.

skills.description: Skills the user wants to train. walk is always first. jump needs a strong, light body.

look.description: Optional cosmetic look; never changes physics.
